# Vendored editor

`toastui-editor.bundle.js` is built by `../../web-vendor/build.mjs` (esbuild) from:

| Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|
| [@toast-ui/editor](https://github.com/nhn/tui.editor) | 3.2.2 | MIT, © NHN Cloud Corp. |
| [ProseMirror](https://prosemirror.net/) (prosemirror-model, -state, -view, -transform, -commands, -history, -inputrules, -keymap) | as resolved in `package-lock.json` | MIT, © Marijn Haverbeke and others — see `LICENSE-prosemirror.txt` |

The license banners of the bundled packages are kept at the end of the bundle.
